article.headline: Sterling Young scores 28 to help Florida A&M secure 76-71 victory over Jackson State
article.description: — Sterling Young finished with 28 points to lead Florida A&M to a 76-71 victory over Jackson State on Saturday night.
article.linkText: Sterling Young scores 28 to help Florida A&M secure 76-71 victory over Jackson State

categories.description: Jackson State Tigers @ Florida A&M Rattlers

event.description: Jackson State Tigers @ Florida A&M Rattlers

keywords: Jackson State Tigers @ Florida A&M Rattlers
article.story: TALLAHASSEE, Fla. -- — Sterling Young finished with 28 points to lead Florida A&M to a 76-71 victory over Jackson State on Saturday night. Young shot 8 for 14 (2 for 5 from 3-point range) and 10 of 10 from the free-throw line for the Rattlers (11-12, 8-4 Southwestern Athletic Conference). Milton Matthews totaled 15 points and five rebounds. Jordan Chatman hit four 3-pointers and scored 14. Shannon Grant led the Tigers (8-17, 8-4) with 14 points. Romelle Mansel had 10 points and six rebounds. Daeshun Ruffin also scored 10. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
